20.decisionCue: A Hook must be activated and scoped to the intended target.

20.title: Separate design, deployment and runtime roles
20.imageBrief: Author→pipeline→CloudFormation execution role→resource APIs; custom provider separate.
learningNotes: Author can edit code without production deployment authority
Deployment role needs scoped CloudFormation and passed service role
Service role creates supported resources; custom Lambda has its own role
Protect IAM/PassRole, KMS, S3 assets and termination actions
Least privilege has multiple roles, not one administrator.
20.decisionCue: Least privilege has multiple roles, not one administrator.

20.title: Walkthrough: safe RDS template update
20.imageBrief: DB v1 template→change-set replacement gate→snapshot/retention→DB v2→health/data validation; failure rollback.
learningNotes: Inspect change set for replacement and data impact
Apply UpdateReplacePolicy/Snapshot as appropriate
Approve during maintenance with backup/restore plan
Deploy and validate endpoint, data and stack events
Do not treat a successful template validation as a safe database replacement.
20.decisionCue: Do not treat a successful template validation as a safe database replacement.

20.title: Walkthrough: import a live S3 bucket
20.imageBrief: Existing bucket→template identifier+policy→import change set→stack ownership→drift report.
learningNotes: Capture bucket name and current configuration
Build full stack template with target bucket and DeletionPolicy
Create IMPORT change set without unrelated create/update
Execute then detect drift and reconcile differences
Import first; alter configuration in a later reviewed update.
20.decisionCue: Import first; alter configuration in a later reviewed update.

20.title: Walkthrough: block an unsafe security group
20.imageBrief: Unsafe template→Guard FAIL; corrected template→Guard PASS→change set→Hook→stack.
learningNotes: Proposed template opens SSH to 0.0.0.0/0
Guard rule fails validation before change set
Hook in fail mode can enforce in deployment
Correct source CIDR, rerun policy and inspect stack events

20.decisionCue: A passing check has meaning only for rules actually configured.

20.imageBrief: Four parallel layers: CDK synth, Guard/Hook deployment validation, Organizations SCP permission boundary, Config postdeployment evaluation. Do not draw as a single mandatory chain.
learningNotes: CDK Aspects inspect or alter the construct tree during synthesis
Guard evaluates templates or change sets where configured
CloudFormation Hooks can warn or block stack operations
SCPs bound principal permissions across an organization; Config detects deployed state

20.decisionCue: Choose a control by the boundary it actually enforces.

20.title: Secrets in IaC: reference, rotate, consume
20.imageBrief: Two alternative secret stores feed CloudFormation resolution at deploy; distinct runtime consumer and rotation paths; no automatic stack update arrow from rotation.

21.imageBrief: CodePipeline stages and action boundaries

21.title: Separate DEV and PROD release paths
21.imageBrief: Separate DEV and PROD release paths

21.imageBrief: Manual approval is a deliberate release gate

21.imageBrief: CodeDeploy targets and deployment types

21.imageBrief: Bedrock evaluation is a release gate

21.imageBrief: Walkthrough: cross-account image release
learningNotes: Build and test a pinned source revision in tooling.
Scan, sign and attest the immutable ECR image digest.

21.title: Walkthrough: failed canary rollback

21.title: Choose the release service by job
21.imageBrief: Choose the release service by job
visualElements: Glossy icons and hairline cyan grid
learningNotes: CodePipeline | Orchestrate stages and approvals | Source → build → test → deploy | Coordinate the release
CodeBuild | Build and test in managed compute | Source + buildspec → artifacts | Compile, test, package
CodeDeploy | Deploy application revisions | Artifact → EC2, Lambda or ECS | Traffic shift and rollback
CodeArtifact | Store packages and dependencies | Package version → repository | Govern reusable packages
21.decisionCue: Pipeline orchestrates; build creates artifacts; deploy changes running workloads.

21.title: Choose a rollout by risk and rollback
21.imageBrief: Choose a rollout by risk and rollback
visualElements: Glossy icons and hairline cyan grid
learningNotes: All at once | Replace all capacity together | Small or tolerant workloads | Fast rollout, largest blast radius
Rolling | Replace batches in place | Capacity can shrink temporarily | Track health between batches
Blue/green | New environment beside old | Fast switch and rollback | Verify green, shift traffic
Canary | Small traffic slice first | High-risk releases | Watch errors and latency before expand
21.decisionCue: Match release pattern to blast radius, capacity headroom, health signals and recovery time.

21.imageBrief: Place release gates at the right boundary
visualElements: Glossy icons and hairline cyan grid

Build | Tests, image scan, SBOM | Promote immutable artifact | Fix and rebuild
Pre-deploy | Policy, template, approval | Permit scoped rollout | Block unsafe change

21.decisionCue: A passing build does not prove a healthy production release.

22.title: Choose telemetry by the question
22.imageBrief: Choose telemetry by the question
visualElements: Glossy icons and hairline cyan grid
learningNotes: Metrics | How much, how often, how healthy? | CloudWatch metrics and alarms | Limited request detail
Logs | What happened in an event? | CloudWatch Logs Insights | Missing context or ingestion
Traces | Where did a request spend time? | X-Ray and OpenTelemetry | Sampling or propagation gaps
Experience | Did users complete a journey? | Synthetics and RUM | Lab versus real user scope
22.decisionCue: Correlate multiple signals before diagnosing the cause.

22.title: Choose the Systems Manager action
22.imageBrief: Choose the Systems Manager action
visualElements: Glossy icons and hairline cyan grid
learningNotes: Session Manager | Interactive node access | Authorized user → managed node | IAM and session audit
Run Command | Execute document across nodes | Tags or resource groups | Bound concurrency and errors
Automation | Run a multi-step playbook | Event, alarm or operator | Validated parameters and roles
Patch Manager | Install approved patches | Baseline + maintenance window | Canary and health check
State Manager | Maintain desired configuration | Association + schedule | Compliance and drift review
22.decisionCue: Use the narrowest action, scope targets, and verify outcome.

22.title: Map an incident to evidence and action
22.imageBrief: Map an incident to evidence and action
visualElements: Glossy icons and hairline cyan grid
learningNotes: Missing logs | Log group, agent, IAM, Region | Collection or delivery | Send one test event
Latency spike | p95, traces, dependency health | Service or downstream | Pause rollout if correlated
Alert storm | Deploy time, composite alarms, SLO | Change or noisy symptom | Confirm customer impact
Unhealthy fleet | Target health, capacity, logs | Node or dependency | Drain and replace safely
Queue backlog | Age, worker errors, retry rate | Worker capacity or poison job | Scale or isolate failed work
22.decisionCue: Diagnose with the fastest reliable signal, then verify customer recovery.
